tasks.title: Repository atomic replace
tasks.description: Add bool TryReplace(string code, ShortLink expected, ShortLink updated) to IUrlRepository and implement it in InMemoryUrlRepository with ConcurrentDictionary.TryUpdate.
risks: Reference-equality semantics of records in TryUpdate: records use value equality, which is fine for CAS here.
tasks.validation: Build succeeds; unit test shows a stale expected value returns false and leaves the link unchanged.

tasks.title: Service: extend logic, remainingSeconds, audit logging
tasks.description: Add ExtendExpiry(code, clientId, additionalSeconds) to ShortenerService: 404, owner 403, validate >0 and <= cap, 409 if deactivated or no expiry, base = max(now, ExpiresAt), reject if newExpiry-now > MaxExpiryMinutes (400), CAS loop with retry. Emit structured audit event for every outcome using ILogger with hashed actor and no raw user text. Extend LinkStats with RemainingSeconds (floor, clamp 0, null if no expiry). Add ExtendStatus/ExtendResult types and wire ILogger in AppHost.
tasks.expectedOutput: Service methods, Results types, AppHost wiring, audit events.
risks: Overflow on huge input; log injection; changing the LinkStats positional record could break existing tests that construct it.
tasks.validation: Service unit tests with a fake TimeProvider pass; audit log entries captured by a test logger contain code, outcome, old and new expiry and no raw client id.

tasks.title: Endpoints: extend and expiry routes
tasks.description: Map POST /api/urls/{code}/extend and PUT /api/urls/{code}/expiry to one handler. Apply rate limiter (429 with Retry-After), handle null/invalid body as 400, map statuses (200 body {code, expiresAt, remainingSeconds}, 400, 403, 404, 409). Add contracts. Leave existing routes untouched.
risks: Route registration order versus /{code}; non-numeric JSON binding must produce 400 not 500.
tasks.validation: Integration tests against the in-process host return the specified statuses; existing endpoint tests still pass.

tasks.title: Integration tests: extend FR-1 and FR-2
tasks.description: Cover success (expiresAt = old + seconds), 404, missing/zero/negative/non-numeric/null body 400, wrong owner 403, cap boundary (exactly 365 days OK, one second more 400), expired revive then GET /r/{code} redirects, deactivated 409 not reactivated, no-expiry 409; both routes; unchanged expiry on failures; audit events for success and denial.
tasks.expectedOutput: Passing test class for extend behaviour.
risks: Time-dependent flakiness: use a fake TimeProvider.
tasks.validation: dotnet test passes; each acceptance criterion of FR-1 and FR-2 has at least one assertion.

tasks.title: Tests: remainingSeconds and backward compatibility FR-3 and FR-4
tasks.description: Verify remainingSeconds for future (floored), expired (0), no expiry (null) on /analytics and /stats; existing fields unchanged; GET /api/urls/{code} shows updated expiresAt after extend; redirect still counts clicks; create and deactivate contracts unchanged.
tasks.validation: dotnet test passes including the pre-existing suite.

tasks.title: Concurrency and latency test
tasks.description: Fire N=50 concurrent extends of S seconds on one link and assert total added is N*S (under the cap) and that with the cap reached the excess requests return 400. Smoke-check p95 under 200 ms in-process.
risks: Latency assertions flaky on CI; keep generous thresholds.
tasks.validation: Final expiresAt equals the initial plus N*S exactly across repeated runs.

tasks.title: Documentation
tasks.description: Document the extend/expiry endpoints, status codes, 365-day cap, special-state rules, remainingSeconds, audit event fields and the spoofable-identity limitation in the README/API docs.
tasks.validation: Docs list every new route, status and field matching the implemented behaviour.
